biotools.summary: BALROG-ISO is a Nextflow pipeline that automates the analysis of bacterial isolate whole genome sequences, performing taxonomic classification, genomic annotation, antimicrobial resistance gene annotation, and prediction of ARG origin. It streamlines workflows and generates a user-friendly report visualizing key metrics and annotation results.
